title: Ruleset: evolution
description: rules/<id>/evolution.yaml: when and into what the partner evolves (docs/reference/evolution.md, game/evolution). Hours are hours of the evolution counter; forms are ids of the digimon table, items ids of the items table.

selection.description: The strategy that picks the target among the candidates (game/evolution: original).

scoring.description: The strategy that scores a candidate against its requirements (game/evolution: original).

check_hours.description: From how many hours of the counter the evolution is checked, by level.

baby_targets.description: The fixed in-training form of each baby.

pass_points.description: The points a candidate needs to pass.

weight_margin.description: How far from the asked weight still scores.

hp_mp_divisor.description: HP and MP are divided by this before comparing them.

mastered_moves_below.description: Only the learned moves with an index of the move table below this count for the moves requirement.

fallback.description: Where a rookie with no candidate goes, and from how many hours.

roll_limit.description: The limit of the one roll each check shares among its rules.

wake_up.description: Checked when the partner wakes up; the last rule that holds wins.

praise_scold.description: Checked after praising or scolding; the last rule that holds wins.

praise_scold_on_timer.description: A partner of this level with the counter at exactly these hours also runs the praise and scold rules.

fixed.description: Items that lead to a fixed form whatever the level.

level_step.description: An item of the item table works when its form is this many levels above the partner.

gain_divisor.description: A stat that reaches the reference adds the reference divided by this.

scale_divisor.description: The scale factor of the scaled targets is in units of 1 / this.

scaled_targets.description: Targets whose stats are scaled instead of gained.

scaled_below_level.description: Targets below this level are scaled too.

ultimate_lifetime_hours.description: Hours of life added on reaching level 5 without an item.

champion_tamer_level_chance.description: Percent chance of a tamer level on reaching level 4.

ultimate_tamer_level_chance.description: Percent chance of a tamer level on reaching level 5.

specialty_blocks.description: The first move of each specialty's block, by specialty.

block_size.description: How many moves a block has.

basic_slot_below_level.description: Below this level the first equipped slot is the first of the list.

finisher_first.description: The fourth equipped slot is the last move of the list from this index...

babies.description: The baby of each egg; the egg is picked at random.

quirks.description: The original's oddities: true reproduces the original, false fixes it.

evolution_item_sticks.description: After an evolution item, every later evolution of the session has no stat gains and no life bonus.

selection_average_carries_over.description: The stat average of a passing candidate that does not become the best carries over to the next one.

unlisted_baby_restarts_timer.description: A baby with no fixed target has its counter set back to 0 at every check.

rookie_stat_tie_picks_last.description: With tied stats, the highest is the last one; false takes the first.

timer_special_overrides_normal.description: At the special counter hour, the special result replaces the normal one even when it finds nothing.

id.description: An id of a table of the packs.

roll_below.description: The shared roll must be below this.

from.description: The partner must be one of these forms.
